== Summary ==
Original Japanese [[Rug Hug (Japanese)|Rug Hug]] from [[Hoth (Japanese)]]. Card-face crop from [https://www.psacard.com/psasetregistry/showcase/miscellaneous/1998-decipher-star-wars-ccg-japanese-hoth-robert-john/imagegallery/32924 Robert John's Japanese Hoth PSA showcase], [https://d1htnxwo4o0jhw.cloudfront.net/cert/148375109/cC43FUTyckSTQHaStxVIMQ.jpg source photograph], PSA certificate 82917282.

Crop rectangle <code>(145, 620, 1290, 2220)</code> after applying the source orientation. Source SHA-256 <code>13bcdc0d3d63983c64806daaa87a0c62fdb7dd365e70255dd8f917b7df9addc0</code>. Lucasfilm Ltd. and Decipher Inc., 1998.
